children: Across nine impactful months, the Learning & Development Africa Rise movement built momentum through a monthly, free pre-conference webinar series. Guided by the overarching theme, "

Reshaping Africa’s Collective Image: Global Access and Opportunities through Learning & Development," these sessions served as a catalyst for critical conversations, thought leadership, and strategic alignment across the continent.

," each webinar addressed pressing organizational needs. The journey culminated on 24 September 2026 with key discussions on data-driven strategy and a collective synthesis in "Reshaping Africa’s Collective Image: What Must Change Now".
Having established the foundational dialogue, the stage is now set for Africa’s L&D leaders, visionaries, and change-makers to gather in person for the main event.
Welcome to the L&D Africa Rise Conference 2026

takes place from 21 to 23 October 2026. Hosted at the lush Garden Venue, this year’s gathering offers a unique, serene setting designed to inspire deep engagement, creative thinking, and meaningful connection.
The conference presents a curated three-day program filled with visionary keynotes, interactive masterclasses, high-level panel discussions, and unmatched networking opportunities.
Day 1: Setting the Stage and Unpacking Key Themes (21 October)
The conference opens with warm greetings, high-energy icebreakers, and a reflection on previous milestones. Highlights from the opening day include:
Key inputs from IFC leadership and keynote speakers.
Panels and presentations focused on Bridging Gender & Rural-Urban Divides (Impact Track 4) and Sustainability in the Age of AI (Impact Track 2).
A deep-dive Masterclass on Impact Measurement & Evidence-based L&D (Impact Track 8).
Live artistic performances, entertainment, a book release by Sello Motsei and dedicated one-on-one networking sessions. Featuring local sensation Natalie Rungan.
Day 2: Deep Dives, Future Skills & Creative Horizons (22 October)
Day 2 delivers actionable insights across the L&D landscape:
Reframing Africa’s Global Identity through L&D
Addresses tackling critical questions such as "
Are our Learners ready to Learn?

An exciting culmination of the day featuring a Vision Quest, Sommelier experience, Book Exhibition by Siegfried Lange, and insights into Strengthening Financial Institutions through L&D (Impact Track 7).
Historic Day 3: First-Ever Immersion Trips (23 October)
For the first time in the history of the L&D Africa Rise Conference, Day 3 steps outside traditional venue walls to offer immersive, real-world field visits.
Attendees will leave the classroom behind to experience impactful projects on the ground.
Guided visits across key regional hubs, including Marshalltown in Johannesburg City Centre, Randjespark in Midrand, and Swartkop in Centurion.
The afternoon transitions to the Syringa Café for a collaborative debrief session, a celebratory dinner, an interactive game show, and the official closing ceremony.
The L&D Africa Rise Conference 2026 is an essential event for HR professionals, L&D practitioners, policy leaders, and innovators dedicated to advancing skill development across the continent.
Don't miss the opportunity to join Africa's premier L&D gathering.

title: ZAWYA: Reshaping Africa’s Future: The Countdown to the LnD Africa Rise Conference 2026
